title: Security Vulnerabilities in dependencies: qs, fast-uri
body:
Security vulnerabilities were found after syncing with the main repo during `pnpm audit`.

### qs
- Vulnerability: qs array-limit bypass via bracket-key comma parsing (CWE-770)
- Vulnerable versions: >=6.14.2 <=6.15.3
- Patched versions: >=6.16.0
- Severity: Moderate

### fast-uri
- Vulnerability: Multiple vulnerabilities including server-side request forgery (SSRF) and host confusion (CWE-436, CWE-20, CWE-918, CWE-174, CWE-177)
- Vulnerable versions: >=4.0.0 <4.1.3
- Patched versions: >=4.1.3
- Severity: High
